rationale: The ? characters in casez items are wildcard match bits on a 2-state input, not X/Z values; every path drives a defined value.
author: claude-sonnet-5-5

labels.note: casez treats Z bits in the selector as wildcards, potentially accepting an invalid input.

settled_by.reason: The casez items cover every binary selector combination and defaults assign both results on every path; wildcard items are intentional decoding.
